At least 30 ECTS credits (or an equivalent workload) in mathematics and computer science have to be documented from the BSc- and MSc-level studies.
A PhD topic should be chosen and a consent of supervision must be given by a member of the PEI board of supervisors.
A thesis committee should be specified.
